title: Windows: Use the common Qt Export and File dialogs
description:
On Windows, use the same common Qt Export and File Dialogs as
other platforms.

We've been using the pre-Windows Vista "Common Dialog Box Library,"
which has been deprecated in favor of the "Common Item Dialog API"
on Windows, but the latter doesn't seem to allow for a way to
control the layout of controls that you add.

The Qt dialogs are much better than the original GTK+ dialogs at
the time that these were made.

Using the same dialogs on all platforms reduces the development
burden and reduces the chance of bugs that show up on one platform
but not others. Mixing old Windows API dialogs with Qt controls
also doesn't seem to work properly with changing DPI scaling values,
especially different values on different monitors.

Fix #17663. Fix #17443. Fix #19288.

added 5 commits

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15302/diffs?diff_id=986666683&start_sha=132093e8c20eca7af70dd61de7aed9c1da925984)

Thanks!

The new Open Capture File dialog does not obey the language (English) that is selected in the Wireshark preferences, it shows the file sizes in localized (Finnish) units (which are incorrect in Finnish, that's the known Qt problem that they are unwilling to fix as a Finnish company). Should I open a new issue, or is someone still working on this somehow?
May be need to update the translation...
